visual_review: Inspected the final full PNG and 512px JPEG. The new worn charcoal cord and three red-ochre, yellow-ochre and chalk-white pebbles read as an earth-pigment cave mark. The inherited central Pepe retains a wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes, and two hands with four fingers and one thumb each. No letters, numerals, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people or prohibited symbols were observed.
visual_limitations: The small lower-left cord-and-pebble motif is intentionally secondary at 512px thumbnail scale.
The inherited rock looks photographic; it was preserved to retain the cave.
